subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Identificar o assunto de um texto, reconhecendo sua organização textual e palavras cognatas.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer palavras cognatas em um texto em inglês para inferir seu tema
components.description_en: Recognize cognate words in an English text to infer its topic
components.cc_component_description: Use surrounding words in a sentence as context clues to infer word meaning

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos de organização textual que sinalizam o tema de um texto em inglês
components.description_en: Identify textual organization features that signal the topic of an English text
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main topic of an informational text

components.description_pt: Determinar o tema de um texto combinando cognatas e pistas organizacionais
components.description_en: Determine the topic of a text by combining cognates and organizational cues
components.cc_component_description: Explain how an author's organizational structure advances understanding of the topic

cc_matches.description: Use sentence-level context as a clue to the meaning of a word or phrase.
Analyze the structure an author uses to organize a text, including how the major sections contribute to the whole and to an understanding of the topic.

Multilingual learners will interpret informational texts in language arts by
* Identifying main topic __and/or entity__ and key details
* Asking and answering questions about descriptions of attributes and characteristics
* Identifying word choices in relation to topic or content area
